question: Find the largest number that divides 68, 102, and 136 to leave the same remainder in each case.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the largest number leaving the same remainder, calculate the HCF of the differences between the numbers.

Difference 1 = 102 − 68 = 34

Difference 2 = 136 − 102 = 34

Required Number = HCF(34, 34) = 34

**∴ The correct answer is 34.**
